exploratory_reason: The state family and grid centre were chosen after daily-bar diagnostics on the development window. The pre-registered grid is a plateau probe, not a clean out-of-sample design.
hypothesis: A four-state leverage ladder driven by QQQ-vs-SPY relative momentum and QQQ's own 150-session trend, with a 70% TQQQ volatility cap, should beat TQQQ's 36.72% development CAGR with a materially lower drawdown.

benchmarks.spy_note: daily close marks only; no SPY 1-minute history for dev

year_concentration.note: Replace one year's strategy return with TQQQ's and recompute the 8-year CAGR; shows one-year dependence.

notes: SPY is a signal only: no SPY 1-minute history exists for 2016-2023.
The relative gate measures both QQQ and SPY through session k-1 so the windows are aligned and SPY's 16:00 close is not anticipated.
The absolute gate and the TQQQ vol cap use the 15:59 close at k.
The holdout (2024-2026) was physically filtered out of the SPY and daily Parquet reads; the panel is hard-sliced at 2023-12-29.
Equity is marked on every 1-minute bar; costs 1/5/10 bp.
The strategy is a leverage ladder (3x/2x/1x/0x), not a market-neutral spread. Its relative gate is highly correlated with Nasdaq beta; see the ablations and static blend.
